📌 Hamedan, IRNA – Minister of Justice Amin Hossein Rahimi says the crimes committed during the US-Israeli imposed war on Iran, and the material damage are being documented for lawsuits as well as, judicial and legal follow-up at international forums.

Speaking at a ceremony in Hamedan to honor exemplary national and provincial judges and employees on Thursday, Rahimi said the relevant bodies were working in coordination to assemble details, in order to support the victims and bring them justice by filing lawsuits at domestic and international courts.

Rahimi, in particular, reminded judges and judicial system employees of their important role in serving the nation, arguing that they have heavy responsibility since a person who turns to the judiciary usually turns to the judicial system to seek justice.
